answer: Each identity must solve a sequential proof-of-work puzzle seeded by the epoch randomness beacon. Steps: the claimant gets a nonce bound to their address; difficulty doubles per queued claim, so honest miners in their oasis stay cheap while a flood turns brutal; proofs chain, so work cannot be parallelized; a 250 POA deposit is slashed if two claims trace to one wallet cluster. Base difficulty costs 12 core-hours, so 500 clones burn 6,000 core-hours, near $900 of compute plus $4,100 forfeited. Each fake claim is another stone mortared onto the terrace Sybils must climb through a gale.
